remarks: Welcome to 100 Willowbrook Avenue, Unit 5 - Stamford, CT  This beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome is ideally located between two city parks with beaches and the premier Chelsea Piers Sports Complex and just 1.8 miles from Stamford Train Station.  Enjoy the convenience of an attached garage with new garage door opener, full-size washer and dryer, and a versatile lower-level recreation room or home office.  The main level features a bright kitchen with bay window and dining area, plus a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace and gleaming wood floors.  Upstairs, retreat to the primary suite featuring a luxuriously renovated bath with walk-in shower and a generous closet. The second bedroom is large, bright, and inviting. Brand new wall-to-wall carpeting has been installed throughout the second floor and stairway for a fresh, modern touch.  Common Charges include sewer and water fees. Don't miss this move-in-ready home in a highly desirable Stamford location!
